# Sources

Pages cite these by id, for example `[KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline][K24]`. The list is generated from `handbook/sources.yml`; to add or correct a source, edit that file (see [Building the handbook](../self-hosting/building-the-handbook.md)). **Licence** says what the handbook may do with each source: KDIGO guidelines are CC BY-NC-ND, so we cite and paraphrase them and never adapt their tables or figures; pages from kidney charities and dialysis providers are linked and paraphrased, never copied.
